The sentiment trend described in the text shows a clear negative shift. Initially, the product or service was praised, but after one month, customer sentiment "took a noticeable dive." This decline is evidenced by widespread complaints on social media regarding poor customer service and unresolved issues, as well as scrutiny of features that failed to meet expectations. The emerging pattern is a rapid deterioration of public perception from positive to negative due to service failures and unmet expectations.
